statistical_conventions.cpu: Thread CPU and switches bracket only the scan, not the full call or measured batch.
statistical_conventions.diagnostic: Descriptive distributions over twenty instrumented samples per depth/direction, with two invocation distributions retained.
statistical_conventions.median: Middle value for odd n, arithmetic mean of two central values for even n.
statistical_conventions.missing: None excluded from quantiles and means, counted explicitly; never replaced with zero.
statistical_conventions.ordinary: Arithmetic mean of the two recorded invocation p50s; not a pooled raw-sample median.
statistical_conventions.p95: Nearest rank: sorted present observations at one-based index ceil(0.95*n).
statistical_conventions.sleep: Requested sleep is a policy counter, not measured asleep time or avoidable delay.
statistical_conventions.sums: Named nonoverlapping phases summed within each sample before distribution; never sum marginal medians.
